title: Weddings
headline: A cover band for your wedding.
lead: One live band for the entire wedding day — from the ceremony and first dance to the evening dancefloor.
trustLine: Big-stage experience in an intimate wedding format: ceremony, live first dance, an original song for the couple and a saxophone welcome.
keywords: wedding cover band, live wedding music, wedding saxophonist, first dance live band, bespoke wedding song

blocks.title: Ceremony
blocks.text: An acoustic lineup for the bride's entrance, vows and signing. The repertoire ranges from Perfect to Pachelbel's Canon.
blocks.imageAlt: Saxophonist performing live at a waterfront wedding ceremony

blocks.title: Welcome
blocks.text: Saxophone or piano solo during guest arrival and reception. Jazz, chillout and lounge that never gets in the way of conversation.

blocks.title: First Dance
blocks.text: A live version of any requested song, prepared especially for your first dance — as in our Shallow and Perfect promo performances.
blocks.imageAlt: First wedding dance accompanied by Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: An Original Song About the Couple
blocks.text: We write a track around your story — how you met, the proposal, names and shared memories — and perform it live at the reception as a surprise gift. Preparation takes 2–3 weeks.
blocks.imageAlt: Original song about the newlyweds performed live at a wedding

blocks.title: Perform Together with the Couple or Family
blocks.text: A wedding home-band format: the couple, parents or friends can come on stage and sing with a live band. We prepare the song in advance and need one short soundcheck at the venue.
blocks.imageAlt: Wedding guests performing on stage with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Reception
blocks.text: The main program: 2×45 or 3×30 minutes with breaks, interactive numbers, flash mobs and guest performances.
blocks.imageAlt: Wedding reception with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Late-Night Set
blocks.text: A dance set, 80s, 90s and 2000s party blocks, and the biggest closing hits.
blocks.imageAlt: Late-night wedding dancefloor with Luxury Cover Band

faq.q: How long is the wedding performance?
faq.a: The main reception program is usually 2×45 or 3×30 minutes with breaks. We adapt the timing to the ceremony, welcome, first dance, dinner and late-night set.

faq.q: Which lineup can we book?
faq.a: From an acoustic duo for the ceremony and welcome to a full big band. We offer lineups of 2–20 performers depending on the venue, format and budget.

faq.q: Can you play our first-dance song?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare a live version of any requested song in advance for your first dance.

faq.q: Can we sing together with the band?
faq.a: Yes. In the home-band format, the couple, parents or friends perform with the live band. We prepare the song in advance and do one short soundcheck at the venue.

faq.q: Do you bring sound equipment?
faq.a: We bring instruments and part of the equipment. The venue provides the standard technical-rider setup and a sound engineer; we agree the exact list for your venue.
faq.aHtml: We bring instruments and part of the equipment. The venue provides the setup listed in our technical rider and a sound engineer; we agree the exact list for your venue.

faq.q: How do we book and get a quote?
faq.a: Message us on Telegram with the date, location and format, and we will send a lineup, timing and quote for your event.

title: New Year Events

headline: A cover band for New Year.
lead: Live music for New Year corporate parties, private celebrations and gala dinners: worldwide hits, guest interaction and a dancefloor, from a duo to the full band.
trustLine: Stadiums, national broadcasts and events for major brands — our December calendar is built from autumn, and early booking secures your preferred lineup.
keywords: New Year cover band, corporate Christmas party live band, gala dinner live music

blocks.title: New Year Corporate Party
blocks.text: A welcome set, a 2×45 or 3×30-minute show with awards and a company anthem, and a dance finale. We coordinate timing with your host and agency.
blocks.imageAlt: New Year corporate dancefloor with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Private New Year Party
blocks.text: A private celebration in a restaurant, loft or country house. We tailor the program to the theme — retro, masquerade or Gatsby — and to the venue's sound limits.
blocks.imageAlt: Luxury Cover Band at a private New Year party

blocks.title: Gala Dinner and Ceremonies
blocks.text: Jazz and lounge for dinner, the formal program and live versions of hits. Choose a compact saxophone lineup or the full band.
blocks.imageAlt: Saxophonist performing at an evening gala dinner

blocks.title: December Dates
blocks.text: Peak dates from 20–28 December are booked first. Early booking secures the date and lineup; we quote immediately and finalize the program closer to the event.
blocks.imageAlt: Full Luxury Cover Band lineup at a December corporate event

faq.q: When should we book for a New Year corporate party?
faq.a: December Fridays and dates from 20–28 December are booked first. Early booking gives you the widest choice of lineup and timing.

faq.q: Do you perform on 31 December and New Year's Eve?
faq.a: Yes, by prior arrangement. Send us the date and venue and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: Can you perform a themed New Year program?
faq.a: Yes. We have six ready-made themed programs and can build a dedicated masquerade, retro or Gatsby set for your evening.

faq.q: How much does a December performance cost?
faq.a: The price depends on the lineup, duration and date. Send the details on Telegram and we will normally return with a quote within a day.

faq.q: What does the venue need to provide?
faq.a: The standard technical rider: a stage or performance area, power and basic sound. We bring part of the backline and coordinate the rest with the venue.

faq.q: Can employees participate?
faq.a: Yes. In the home-band format employees perform with live accompaniment, with or without a rehearsal.
